lines: The mechanical spiders eventually exited the tunnel and went above ground.
This is... an abandoned city. I didn't know the tunnel was connected to a place like this.
Be careful, all of you. It looks like the target is right under our noses.
Yes, Hebiko also noticed! The presence of someone can be felt close by.
The sucker sensors on Hebiko's octopus tentacles twitched as they sensed the presence of an enemy.
(There are ruins all around us, with plenty of places to hide. It's the perfect place for an ambush.)
Tch! I thought we were chasing them, but it might have been the other way around...
As if in response to his voice, the figure of a woman glided into view.
It hath been some time since we last met.
It was Yao Bikuni, an underboss of the Fuma Ninja Forces who served the Nisha Clan.
It was said that she had served them since the time of the first Fuma Kotaro. But if that were true, then she would have been alive for 500 years...
And from behind Yao Bikuni, even more Fuma ninja appeared one by one.
That's quite a welcome. What about Gaiza?
Gaiza-sama hath already taken his leave.
Then let us through. I've got business with him.
I have for thee a message from Gaiza-sama. He sayeth thou art an "eyesore."
I had been optimistic in some respects that things would turn out alright if we could meet and talk to Gaiza.
But that thought easily fell to pieces.
(This guy... Is Gaiza really going to bury us to achieve his ambitions...?)
W-Will we be alright, Fuma...? That woman is super strong, isn't she...? She can shoot... something from her eyes...
Yeah. Yao Bikuni is a powerful Evil Eye user.
Evil Eye users were pretty common in the Fuma Clan, but her power was truly evil.
She could suck out the life energy of anyone she looked at, turning it into her own life energy, and then turn the victim into a deformed monster resembling half man and half fish.
I think it was called Mermaid's Sapphire Eyes.
It is an honor that thou holdest thoughts of me in thy hearts.
Hmmm. Hebiko's wondering what she would turn into if her life energy had been sucked out?
Hebiko wiggled her octopus tentacles and spoke nonchalantly. It seemed that she had grown a bit through her deadly battle in the Chaos Arena.
Aishu Hebiko. Thou hast become one who speaketh quite in jest.
I feel pretty good about this. If we know what she's capable of, we should be able to deal with her. Everyone, follow my lead.
G-Got it...! But please, Fuma...! I don't want to turn into a half-man, half-fish monster!!
...Oh, am I going to fight too? I mean it's fine and all.
Hebiko, Shikanosuke, and Akitsu turned to face Yao Bikuni.
...O-hohoho, I see thou art as ever the winsome and witless head of the clan.
Fuma Ninja Forces, heed my command. Lay to eternal rest this fool of the past!!
